The structure of LiV2CrO6 crystallizes in the trigonal space group R-3m (No. 166), with a unit cell containing 30 atoms—Li6 V12 Cr6 O18—distributed over five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies Cr, Li, and V centers each coordinated by six O neighbors in octahedral motifs, with Cr–O distances of 1.919–1.935 Å, Li–O distances of 2.145–2.153 Å, and V–O distances of 1.976–2.027 Å. O-centered octahedra show corner- and edge-sharing, and the geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 30 sites.
